description: Clears a status variable, sets a register to a fixed constant and calls seven helper routines.

name: initialise_status_one_and_helpers
description: Sets a status variable to one and a counter to two, sets a fixed constant, and calls helper routines.

name: interleave_tile_graphics_planes
description: Copies word tiles from a graphics table into interleaved bitplane buffers, then calls loaders for the BIGCHAR.IFF and PANEL.SPR assets.

name: load_indexed_sprite_pair
description: Looks up a 32-bit resource entry by index, calls the loader for it, and loads a second entry when one is present.

name: load_indexed_resource_entry
description: Looks up a 32-bit resource entry by index, stores it in the loader's argument and calls the loader for a fixed buffer offset.

name: load_arthur1_sprite_file
description: Zeroes an offset, points the loader at the shared buffer, loads ARTHUR1.SPR and advances the offset by the buffer value.

name: load_weapon_sprite_files
description: Sets a fixed size and buffer pointer, then loads WEAPONS.SPR and WEAPONS1.SPR in turn, resetting the pointer between them.

name: load_chest_sprite_file
description: Points the loader at the shared buffer and loads the CHEST.SPR sprite file.

name: load_table_indexed_resource
description: Reads a 32-bit table entry by index, stores it in the loader argument and calls the loader.

name: load_skeleton_sprite_file
description: Points the loader at the shared buffer and loads the SKELETON.SPR sprite file.

name: load_bigpig_sprite_file
description: Points the loader at the shared buffer and loads the BIGPIG.SPR sprite file.

name: load_shield_sprite_file
description: Points the loader at the shared buffer and loads the SHIELD.SPR sprite file.

name: load_devil_sprite_file
description: Points the loader at the shared buffer and loads the DEVIL.SPR sprite file.

name: load_cerberus_sprite_file
description: Points the loader at the shared buffer and loads the CERBERUS.SPR sprite file.

name: load_sprite_and_scale_offset
description: Calls the loader twice around a step that scales a value read from memory and advances the buffer offset.

name: load_spic_after_raster_wait
description: Waits for a raster line, stores three fixed words, points the loader at the shared buffer and loads the SPIC.IFF image.

name: load_indexed_entry_after_wait
description: Saves a counter, calls several helpers and a raster wait, then loads the table entry at the counter minus one.

name: copy_longword_block_interleaved
description: Copies longwords from a source block into a destination buffer in a nested pattern that reads four rows at a time.

name: draw_four_column_rows
description: Calls a routine across four entries per row, advances the pointer by forty-two bytes after each row, and stops when the routine returns zero.

name: scan_for_iff_body_chunk
description: Scans forward word by word until it finds the four-character tag BODY that begins image data.

name: unpack_byterun_row
description: Decodes one row of PackBits-compressed image data into forty output bytes, handling literal runs and repeat runs.

name: draw_text_string_with_glyphs
description: Reads a text string and draws each character from a glyph table, running control codes through a handler table and treating spaces as a blank glyph.

name: copy_two_record_bytes
description: Copies two bytes from offsets one and two of an input record into two global variables.

name: compute_two_plane_pointers
description: Looks up a longword by a byte index and adds a per-plane base offset to produce two pointers stored in globals.

name: step_column_sequence_writes
description: Stores a column index and loops four times, calling helpers and advancing the column index between each pass.

name: compute_plane_row_offset
description: Computes a memory offset from the row value and the column index using a row stride of forty bytes.

name: lookup_digit_nibble_or_default
description: Looks up a digit character in a hex digit string and returns it shifted to the high nibble, or a fixed default when no digit applies.

name: lookup_digit_nibble_or_default
description: Looks up a digit character in a hex digit string and returns it shifted to the high nibble, or a fixed default when no digit applies.

name: lookup_digit_high_nibble
description: Looks up a digit character in a hex digit string and returns its value shifted to the high nibble.

name: copy_eight_rows_to_planes
description: Copies one byte pair per row into a plane pair and clears the matching bytes in two other planes, over eight rows at a stride of forty bytes.

name: fill_rows_from_constant_pattern
description: Fills 200 rows of a buffer by writing a fixed ten-longword pattern into each row.

name: fill_counted_rows_with_pattern
description: Writes the same ten-longword pattern into four planes, with the row count taken from a variable.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls a single helper routine and returns.

name: swap_two_pointer_pairs
description: Toggles a pair of stored values between two fixed constants on each call.

name: set_pointer_pair_defaults
description: Sets two stored pointer values to fixed constants.

name: store_five_buffer_addresses
description: Stores five buffer addresses, each computed as a base address plus a fixed offset, into a pointer table.

name: shift_wide_value_left
description: Shifts a 32-bit value held in two words left by one bit, feeding in a bit from a status byte and returning the carried-out byte.

name: poll_helpers_until_done
description: Calls three helpers, then repeatedly calls another helper with a fixed argument until its result clears, looping while the outer result is nonzero.

name: decrement_three_nibble_fields
description: Subtracts one from each of the three low four-bit fields of a word when that field is nonzero.

name: poll_helpers_with_two_pointers
description: Calls three helpers, then repeatedly calls a helper with two pointer arguments until its status clears.

name: step_nibble_fields_toward_target
description: Compares the three low four-bit fields of two words and increments each field of the destination that differs from the source.

name: set_blitter_constant_registers
description: Writes fixed values to the blitter control and modulo registers to configure the blitter for its next operation.
